summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement of a grant of conditional share awards, the US-equivalent disclosure for a routine equity incentive allotment. On 4 November 2026 the company granted awards over 336,726 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each under the HSBC Share Plan 2011 to employees and former employees at a purchase price of GBP 0, with the London closing price at grant GBP 13.182. Vesting runs three years (33%/33%/34%), with longer periods for Material Risk Takers plus 12-month retention. No special-situations event; watch only dilution capacity, with 1,111,855,862 and 355,401,930 shares remaining under the 10% and 5% plan limits.
